assessments.reasoning: On printed page 1 IBM describes CLIST as interpretive and says that its documented test workflow uses execution and correction without a prior compile-and-link-edit stage.

challenge.method: Read the surrounding introduction and the application categories on printed pages 1 and 2. Checked whether the no-compilation statement attaches to CLISTs or to other software that a CLIST can manage.
challenge.results: The testing paragraph refers to CLISTs. The manual separately describes CLISTs managing programs in other languages. The claim properly stays at the documented model.

limitations: No actual TSO/E execution or property of an invoked program was verified.
